description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Step 1 of attaching a LOCAL file (video, image or audio) to a draft. Returns a single-use, short-lived `uploadUrl`. Step 2: POST the raw file bytes to it with the file's Content-Type, e.g. `curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: video/mp4" --data-binary @clip.mp4 "<uploadUrl>"` — the JSON response has a `storageId`. Step 3: pass it as `videoStorageId` or `imageStorageId` on create_content or update_content. For music-library audio, pass storageId to music_tracks_create instead. For media already on the web, skip this and pass `videoUrl` / `imageUrl` instead. Returns 413 when the account's storage is full.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/media/upload-url.)
name: upload_media
title: Get a media upload URL
